name: Modal
description: A dialog over a dimmed page, in four sizes, with a scrolling body and a confirm variant.

props.name: children
props.description: A button that opens the modal, then the Modal or AlertDialog.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the modal opens or closes.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of 400, 520 or 720 pixels, or the whole window less 24 pixels all round.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Escape always closes unless isKeyboardDismissDisabled is set.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Shows a close button in the top right corner.

props.name: role
props.description: Use alertdialog for a confirmation that interrupts.

props.name: children
props.description: ModalHeader, ModalBody and ModalFooter. A function receives close(). Any button with slot="close" also closes.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state, when used without a ModalTrigger.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes, when used without a ModalTrigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the scrim.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Holds the title and description and stays put while the body scrolls.

props.name: children
props.description: The modal's name. Labels the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: A line or two under the title. Describes the dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Scrolls between the header and footer when the content is tall, with a hairline on the side that has more to read.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Actions aligned to the end; put the main action last.

props.name: title
props.description: The question, e.g. "Delete Hakuba traverse?".

props.name: children
props.description: What will happen.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the confirming button. Say what it does.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label of the cancel button, which takes focus first.

props.name: tone
props.description: Destructive makes the action camellia and shows a warning icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the default icon. Pass null for none.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called on confirm. The dialog then closes; a returned promise shows a spinner until it settles.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the panel.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked.
